2608.25775.title: ToST: A Tree-of-Thought Socratic Teaching Framework for Multi-Path Guidance and Parallel Thinking
2608.25775.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong problem-solving abilities, positioning them as promising agents for Socratic teaching to guide students through step-by-step heuristic questioning. However, existing approaches typically adopt a one-problem-one-solution paradigm, restricting the teaching guidance to a single linear reasoning path. This design limits instructional flexibility, weakens error recovery, and restricts students' ability to engage in parallel thinking to explore multiple valid solutions. To overcome these, we propose ToST, a Tree-of-Thought Socratic Teaching framework that explicitly supports multi-path guidance under a one-problem-multiple-solutions paradigm. ToST employs Parallel Sowing, a parallel-thinking-oriented questioning strategy to encourage students to approach problems from diverse perspectives, and a Multi-Path Adaptive Guidance mechanism to provide more robust and non-linear instructions across alternative solution trajectories. Concurrently, to fill the void in systematically evaluating such non-linear instructional capabilities, we advance the task of multi-path Socratic guidance by establishing MPSG-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that includes a dataset of 31K multi-path teaching dialogues and a five-dimensional evaluation framework grounded in the SOLO (Structure of Observed Learning Outcomes) theory to assess parallel-thinking guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that ToST significantly enhances guidance success rates while empowering students to navigate and explore multiple solution paths more effectively under both automatic and human metrics.
2608.25775.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）展現出強大的問題解決能力，使其成為蘇格拉底教學的有前景的代理人，以引導學生通過逐步的啟發式提問。然而，現有的方法通常採用一題一解的範式，將教學指導限制在單一的線性推理路徑上。這種設計限制了教學的靈活性，削弱了錯誤恢復的能力，並限制了學生進行平行思考以探索多種有效解決方案的能力。為了克服這些問題，我們提出了ToST，一個樹狀思維的蘇格拉底教學框架，明確支持在一題多解的範式下進行多路徑指導。ToST採用平行播種，一種以平行思考為導向的提問策略，鼓勵學生從不同的角度來看待問題，以及一個多路徑自適應指導機制，以在替代解決路徑中提供更強大且非線性的指導。同時，為了填補系統評估這種非線性教學能力的空白，我們推進了多路徑蘇格拉底指導的任務，建立了MPSG-Bench，一個綜合基準，包括31K多路徑教學對話的數據集和一個基於SOLO（觀察學習結果結構）理論的五維評估框架，以評估平行思考指導。實驗結果顯示，ToST顯著提高了指導成功率，同時使學生能夠在自動和人為指標下更有效地導航和探索多種解決路徑。
2608.25775.author: Feng Ling et.al.
